text:
nina: Quick thread: KV Partners wants marketplace listing for "KV-Atlas-13B" and is asking for two delivery options: hosted + downloadable weights. Need legal/export + ops checklist.
ash: clarify downloadable = full weights tarball for customers to self-host?
devon: yes. Also they want a 'partner-hosted' remote-exec option where traffic is routed to their endpoint (partner-managed). Different billing and SLA implications.
partner-kv: we can provide weights bundle, signed OCI runner, and provenance attestation (OpenKey v2 + SLSA). We prefer downloadable SKU to broaden reach.
legal-bot: For downloadable SKUs we require explicit redistribution permission in contract. Options: "no-download", "download-with-attribution", or "download-sublicensable". Provide insurer info if partner resists indemnity.
nina: partner gives dual-license (Apache2 + commercial addendum). Is that workable?
ash: dual-license fine, but commercial addendum must include a redistribution clause matching marketplace policy.
devon: ops: checklist items I'll need:
- signed manifest (pgp)
- container digest for remote-exec
- SRI for weights
- inference profile (p50/p95, tokens/sec)
- telemetry preference (aggregated only)
- download_allowed: true|false and kms_key if true
partner-kv: we'll attach signed manifest and can do aggregated telemetry only. For indemnity we can offer limited warranty + takedown agreement; partner has E&O insurance (we'll share binder).
legal-bot: limited warranty ok if insurance meets threshold. I'll open EX ticket for export classification (NL origin) and PL ticket to evaluate indemnity workaround. Need insurer binder and attestation.
nina: marketing note: partner requested 2-week embargo and co-announcement checklist. Also wants us to include partner logo and a short quote. Legal: do partner quotes need approval signature?
legal-bot: partner quote ok but must be approved and stored in PR package; logos must be approved via brand board. We'll require partner signoff asset by T-3 days.
devon: technical profile from partner pasted:
"seq_len: 2048; p50: 40ms@8gpu; p95: 120ms; throughput: 150 rps@8gpu; quantizations: fp16,int8"
ops-bot: Staging actions: create tile in staging, enable canary routing for remote-exec, and gate downloadable SKU behind legal flag. Will annotate SKU metadata with "download_allowed": "false" until legal clears.
partner-kv: will upload insurer binder and SLSA attestation by Thu EOD.
legal-bot: opened tickets EX-4890 (export) and PL-9001 (indemnity review). Target response Fri 17:00 UTC.
nina: action list:
- @legal-bot: export + indemnity decision by Fri EOD
- @devon: prepare staging tile + metadata, gate download flag
- @ops-bot: setup canary for remote-exec and billing counters (aggregated telemetry only)
- @partner-kv: upload insurer + provenance artifacts by Thu EOD
If any blocker, escalate here. thanks! :raised_hands:
